newValues.collection.storage: explicit nonsecret endpoint/bucket/prefix/region map, no global raw fallback
newValues.collection.resources: current ordinary role defaults, independent override

existingSharedSelector: integrationKeySecret{name,key}; required when collection enabled, optional when core-only preconfigured
offSemantics: Empty selections and false/absent feature preserve old outputs; complete storage+RO preconfiguration may be supplied without publisher; any supplied publisher tuple must also be complete.
isolationRule: Reader and publisher selector tuples must not be identical. Same Secret name with different key names is a positive control. Reference inequality does not certify different bytes or real rights.
imageEvidence: Source Containerfile/host command inventory and complete bin COPY only, no image build or executable-existence claim.
quadlet: New aspm-collection.container with one protected collection.env, isolation/tmp/restart settings, no Install target. Real existing Podman4.9 unprivileged dryrun; no systemd/podman activation.
